Product Overview:
This collection includes a variety of mineral and rock specimens featuring polished and raw stones. Included are carved sandstone, quartz geode, cubic calcite, amethyst cluster, and a bright blue-green crystal possibly fluorite or amazonite. Additional specimens include geode halves, black tourmaline, clear quartz, polished agate slices, obsidian, and various sedimentary and metamorphic rocks.

- Types of Specimens: Sandstone, quartz geode, calcite, amethyst, fluorite/amazonite, black tourmaline, clear quartz, agate, obsidian, sedimentary and metamorphic rocks
- Condition: Natural variations in color and texture present
- Appearance: Mixture of polished and raw stones

277322904.description:
Natural Gemstone Specimen Collection
Semi-Precious Gemstones
Total Weight: 1.42 lbs
34 Total Specimen Units
This comprehensive collection features a diverse array of natural semi-precious gemstones, primarily polished into cabochons for jewelry making or display. The lot includes a wide variety of mineral types such as rhodonite, unakite, and jasper, showcasing a spectrum of colors from deep greens and earthy reds to vibrant pinks and mottled grays. Housed in a professional display case with 31 individual clear-top specimen containers and 3 additional baggies, this set is ideal for lapidary work, educational study, or private collections.
31 individual clear-lidded specimen jars and 3 supplemental stone baggies
Variety of cabochon shapes including oval, round, marquise, and rectangular cuts
Broad range of natural mineral specimens with polished finishes
Black professional specimen display case with foam protective insert
Condition:
The gemstones appear to be in excellent condition with smooth, polished surfaces and minimal visible inclusions or surface wear. The exterior display case and individual plastic containers show minor scuffs, scratches, and light dust consistent with handling. Two slots in the display case are empty. Sold as a complete collection in as-is condition.
